content.title: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Gumroad payhip

Gumroad and Payhip offer digital storefronts with payment processing, but they rely on Stripe or PayPal, excluding creators from restricted countries. These platforms also take a significant cut of sales, with fees ranging from 3.5% to 8% + $0.30 per transaction. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure provides a base-layer solution, allowing creators to own their entire sales funnel, with no platform fees or restrictions.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Gumroad and Payhip are bound by the same restrictions as Stripe and PayPal, effectively locking out creators from countries like Nigeria, Ghana, and Kenya. This limitation stems from the underlying payment infrastructure, which is often tied to traditional banking systems. Sovereign commerce infrastructure, on the other hand, utilizes cryptocurrency payments, bypassing these restrictions and enabling creators to reach a global audience.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Traditional payment platforms like Gumroad and Payhip often incur high fees, with payment processing times ranging from a few days to several weeks. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure leverages cryptocurrency payments, which offer near-instant settlement and significantly lower fees, typically around 0.5% per transaction. This reduction in fees and payment processing time translates to increased earnings and faster access to funds for creators.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure empowers creators.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Sovereign commerce infrastructure empowers creators to own their entire sales funnel, from payment processing to product delivery. With automation tools like Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, creators can streamline their workflow, ensuring efficient and secure delivery of digital products. This level of control and automation is unparalleled in traditional payment platforms, which often dictate the terms of sale and ownership.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

The storefront in a COREMERCH deployment is a static site hosted on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. It costs nothing to host. It scales to any traffic level automatically. It cannot be taken down by a payment platform's compliance decision because the hosting and the payment layer are completely separate infrastructure. Your buyer experience is clean and professional — a product page, a crypto checkout with QR code generation and live price feeds, and an automatic delivery email within 30 seconds of payment. Every component runs under your own accounts. If COREMERCH closed tomorrow, every store deployed would continue running exactly as it does today. That is what infrastructure ownership means.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

The direct answer is NOWPayments combined with a sovereign commerce stack. NOWPayments is a crypto payment processor that requires no KYC from merchants and no account creation from buyers. It supports over 300 coins, charges 0.5% per transaction, and sends a webhook to your backend the moment payment confirms on-chain. Your backend — a Cloudflare Worker in Stack 02, a Google Apps Script Web App in Stack 01 — receives the webhook, verifies the transaction hash on the blockchain, logs the order, generates a receipt, and sends the delivery email automatically. There is no platform that can suspend your access, no compliance team that can flag your account, no payout schedule that delays your revenue, and no company that can change the rules on you tomorrow.
Cryptocurrency payments bypass traditional restrictions.

The Edge Commerce Stack, available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html, empowers digital creators to take control of their online business, offering a scalable and secure solution for restricted countries. This product provides a comprehensive framework for building a sovereign commerce infrastructure, complete with automated payment processing and product delivery.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy a sovereign commerce infrastructure, follow these steps: choose a hosting platform like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, select a backend logic tool like Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, set up a payment gateway like NOWPayments, configure automated product delivery, and test your sales funnel. With these steps, creators can establish a reliable and efficient online business, free from traditional payment restrictions.
